stories.headline: WhatsApp group chat used to send millions in cash, funding crime and extremism
stories.description: The WhatsApp money launderers arranged cash transfers in the UK and around the world with no paper trail.

stories.headline: Israeli soldiers participate in Sydney Marathon despite protests
stories.description: Protesters waved Palestinian flags and criticised the Australian government for issuing visas to 40 Israeli soldiers.

stories.headline: What’s behind Netanyahu’s condemnation of this weekend’s settler pogroms?
stories.description: Israel’s rhetorical outrage masks a calculated, well-funded campaign to permanently erase Palestinian statehood.

stories.headline: Trump says US will refill its petroleum reserves using Venezuelan oil
stories.description: President Donald Trump says in a post that the ‘topping out’ process will ‌begin shortly.

stories.headline: Children at a Nepal school escape floods thanks to their lunch break and alert teachers
stories.description: Schoolchildren in Nepal survived a catastrophic flood by leaving their classrooms for lunch.
